Data types and typeof

JavaScript has seven primitive types: string, number, bigint, boolean, undefined, symbol and
null. Other values are objects; functions are callable objects.
Primitive values සරල හා immutable values. Array, object, function යන ඒවා object category

Interview question: How can you identify an array reliably?
Answer: Use Array.isArray(value); typeof alone returns object.
